summary: Comprehensive testing of AnalytiCore Analysis features. All backend APIs passed (100%). Fixed critical bug: file_path/processed_file_path fields were missing from ProjectSerializer causing Analysis tab to be always disabled. After fix, all 4 Analysis Dashboard tabs (Statistics, Correlation, Distribution, Visualize) work correctly with proper data visualization.

fixed.issue: ProjectSerializer missing file_path and processed_file_path fields
fixed.impact: Analysis tab was always disabled in frontend because project.file_path was always null
fixed.fix: Added file_path and processed_file_path to serializer fields list

Chart Data API - pie chart with percentages
Chart Data API - histogram chart
Chart Data API - box plot chart
